title: Glimmering Gloop Gulper
statement: A translucent, lantern-bellied anglerfish-cousin, the Gloop Gulper drifts through a moonlit tank of indigo water and swaying kelp, slowly inhaling tiny glowing motes and burbling out soft, golden bubbles that cling to the glass like fireflies. Curious and a bit shy, it nudges a tilted teacup on the sandy floor, its cozy hideaway, and lights up in a rosy blush whenever a visitor comes near.
